messages:
alex_chiu: FYI starting thread for ACME private rollout — quick status + blockers for networking / air-gap. tagging owners. blockers noted below.

priya_s: ACME confirmed they can open peering, but asked for CIDR confirmation. I requested their VPC CIDR, waiting on reply.

matt_dev: on our side, the registry mirror and manifest builder for the private bundle is not ready yet — working on the mirrorer. ETA EOD tomorrow.

jen_ops: got the firewall rule list from ACME. Missing 10.0.5.0/24 for metrics push (prometheus). we need security approval to add it.

kyle_net: question — can we use site-to-site VPN or do they want Direct Connect? ACME prefers dedicated VPN. Need PSK + ASN from their network team. I emailed acme-net.

alex_chiu: Owner matrix (quick): infra = mirror + manifests; eng-platform = deploy config + rollout; network = peering/vpn + fw; security = signing + attestation. Confirm? :white_check_mark:

priya_s: security requires signed images + cosign-based workflow for airgapped. Blocked until devops provides offline signing key and process. security-bot asked for KMS/HSM details.

security-bot: security: Please confirm KMS access method — HSM-backed key is required for production private deployments. Provide vendor contact or KMS plan for ACME.

matt_dev: For cosign offline workflow I'm prototyping a small script. snippet:
```
COSIGN_KEY=/keys/offline.key
cosign sign --key $COSIGN_KEY registry.local/acme/model:sha256
```
I'll open a PR with the docs and example.

jen_ops: also a reminder: ACME cannot reach public apt/yum repos. we need to supply package tarballs or a package mirror. they asked for instructions for an internal mirror.

kyle_net: firewall entry 10.0.5.0/24 added to our proposed ruleset. ACME network lead must sign off by EOD Wed to stay on schedule.

alex_chiu: Tests & schedule: who runs acceptance? priya do you own acceptance tests (smoke + perf baseline)?

priya_s: yes, I'll run acceptance and perf smoke. scheduling Wed 10am PT. Need data-plane creds and a kubeconfig from ops.

matt_dev: ops — can you hand off a one-time kubeconfig? note that image pull secret will point to the mirrored registry; I'll update helmvalues accordingly.

jen_ops: creating one-time kubeconfig now and will upload to secure share. also adding quick instructions for pulling from mirror:
```
kubectl create secret docker-registry regcreds --docker-server=registry.local --docker-username=acme --docker-password=... -n redwood
```

alex_chiu: Open items checklist (tracking):
- [ ] ACME CIDR confirmed
- [ ] VPN PSK + ASN received
- [ ] Firewall allowlist (metrics port)
- [ ] Offline image signing + cosign key in place
- [ ] Package mirrors or tarballs for apt/yum
- [ ] Kubeconfig + pull secrets provided
- [ ] Security sign-off obtained

kyle_net: I'll ping acme-net again and include their contact. putting owner tags in the tracker.

acme-net-bot: acme-net: Received request, will reply with PSK and ASN by tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

priya_s: if anything blocks acceptance tests ping me directly. leaving notes in Asana task #ACME-129.

matt_dev: ETA for mirror infra is tomorrow EOD. blocking only if network or SFTP details are delayed.

jen_ops: quick follow-up: for the model weights transfer — do we ship via SFTP or provide a signed tarball download? ACME prefers SFTP drop. I'll coordinate.

alex_chiu: ok jen, coordinate SFTP details with acme-net contact. once signed images + weights are on SFTP we can run staging cutover.

kyle_net: assigned owners updated in the tracker. I'll DM the ACME lead for the firewall sign-off and loop security if anything changes.

alex_chiu: thanks everyone — I'll update the rollout board after acceptance run. :rocket:

matt_dev: LGTM

priya_s: :thumbsup:
